name: Marrowlight Ossuary
introDiscord:
Small luminous creatures have colonized the hollow bones, filling the
Ossuary with soft inner light.

It would be beautiful if some of the lights weren't Angler lures.
introTwitch:
Small luminous creatures have colonized the hollow bones, filling the
Ossuary with soft inner light.

It would be beautiful if some of the lights weren't Angler lures.

marrowlight-ossuary-approach.prompt: Three passages cross glowing ribs and vertebrae.

left.message:
A pleasant light shines inside a hollow bone.

It develops teeth.

Of course.

right.message:
One Berry rests beside Shizuki's field guide:

'Bone light:
pretty.

Angler light:
pretty + teeth.

Why does every region require this chart?'

forward.message: A strongbox glows beneath marrowlight creatures.

left.message:
A mineral pool glows beneath a hollow vertebra.

Shizuki wrote:

'Night-light skeleton.

Horrifying phrase.

Surprisingly cozy.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the cozy skeleton pool untouched.

right.message:
A Marrowlight Angler mimics the harmless creatures perfectly until the
mouth appears.

forward.message: Star Candies glitter within the lit bone.

left.message: A navigator's chest rests inside the Leviathan skull.

right.message:
Shizuki's bottle says:

'Slept inside skull.

Glimmer says this is weird.

Glimmer slept in eye socket.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative and avoid adjudicating hypocrisy.

forward.message:
A light shines from the second eye socket.

This one has an Angler attached.

boss-antechamber.name: Lit Skull Chapel
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every harmless marrowlight creature leaves the skull.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every harmless marrowlight creature leaves the skull.

One enormous lantern remains glowing inside its jaws.

Use /yes to enter Lit Skull Chapel or /no to decline whatever is using
a Leviathan skull as a lamp.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every harmless marrowlight creature leaves the skull.

One enormous lantern remains glowing inside its jaws.

Use !yes to enter Lit Skull Chapel or !no to decline whatever is using
a Leviathan skull as a lamp.
bossRetreatText: You back away from the illuminated skull.

boss.revealText:
The light swings forward and an enormous Angler emerges.

Bone-Lantern Angler reveals itself!

completionText:
The Bone-Lantern retreats.

The harmless marrowlights return.

The skull becomes strangely beautiful again.
